notes: Traps, priority order: (1) the daddy shard ROTATES (hamis today, something else tomorrow) — the output Referer must be derived as origin_of the captured daddy URL, never written down; a hardcoded shard is a dead recipe. (2) Referers are exact-URL chained, not domain-level: watch page wants the 24-7 listing referer, dlstreams wants the exact watch URL, daddy wants the exact dlstreams URL, the master wants the daddy ORIGIN. (3) The m3u8 200s only with that origin referer — the verify step is the proof the chain walked correctly; a master that fails verify usually means the shard rotated mid-chain. (4) Secure URLs are IP-bound to the minting machine (180 min TTL) — which is exactly why this recipe runs on the box, not in a feed builder. (5) dlhd reorgs rotate the whole id space without notice; ids come from the ntv.cx catalog, and stale ids serve UNRELATED live-event pages — a chain that resolves but plays the wrong event means the id space rotated, not that this recipe broke.
